name: Flabellum
description: A folded fan: the pleats read as alternating light and dark because each rib is its own ink.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 15deg, transparent 15deg 30deg); mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 15deg, transparent 15deg 30deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from 15deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 15deg, transparent 15deg 30deg); mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from 15deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 15deg, transparent 15deg 30deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
